Name: floor2-elite-point-target-recruitmax
Description: The SAME floor-2 Elite fight as floor2-elite-point-target.json, but with the recruit-max growth path's retinue (60 units, 20% Archers) instead of balanced's 50 -- run as a companion pair specifically to test scaling-curve.md §4's headline finding through the committed harness instead of trusting its scratch-script table alone: recruit-max has MORE total bodies but is claimed to lose this point-target matchup to balanced, because melee is capped at the Elite's SurroundCapEstimate (20) regardless of army size, so recruit-max's extra headcount above that cap should be worth zero here.
SourceRefs: docs/design/scaling-curve.md §2 'Recruit-max' table, Floor 2 start row (60 units, 12 Archers/20%)
Notes: Companion to floor2-elite-point-target.json (balanced path) -- run both and compare TTK directly rather than trust the design doc's scratch numbers. Reproduces (not necessarily exactly) scaling-curve.md §4's 'recruit_max_floor2_elite' row (TTK 2.58s, MeleeDPS 266.7 from 20-of-48 capped Spearmen, ArcherDPS 40.0, HeroDPS 41.7). Same clean-1-on-1 lower-bound caveat as the balanced scenario -- see its Notes. This scenario deliberately does NOT apply the recruit-max path's floor-3 degrade multiplier (0.944, scaling-curve.json retinue_growth_curve) because that multiplier is a FLOOR-3 number (recruit-max only crosses the degrade threshold on floor 3, per that table's DegradeMultiplier column) -- floor 2's recruit-max row is still at DegradeMultiplier 1.0, so no adjustment is needed here; this is stated explicitly so the omission doesn't read as an oversight.
